## Objective
- Build a complete playable 2D pixelated Jujutsu Kaisen-inspired fighting game for phones and tablets, including menus, fighter selection, practice and regular battles, special abilities, and ultimate attacks.

## Requirements
- Practice opponent stays still; regular battle opponent moves and attacks.
- Include the requested character roster and support phone/tablet touch controls.

- Practice opponent stays still; battle opponent moves and attacks.
- Include the requested roster and support phone/tablet touch controls.

- Added Aoi Todo to the roster.

- Verified ultimate activation, pause/resume, results, and rematch flows.

- `index.html`: Game screens, controls, and favicon declaration.

- `game.js`: Roster, combat, AI, and input handling.

  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

Install:
